name: oh-my-opencode-workspace
description: The Best AI Agent Harness - Batteries-Included OpenCode Plugin with Multi-Model Orchestration, Parallel Background Agents, and Crafted LSP/AST Tools

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun build packages/oh-my-opencode/src/index.ts --outdir packages/oh-my-opencode/dist --target bun --format esm --external @ast-grep/napi && bun build packages/opencode-task-delegation/src/index.ts --outdir packages/opencode-task-delegation/dist --target bun --format esm --external @ast-grep/napi && bun build packages/opencode-lsp-tools/src/index.ts --outdir packages/opencode-lsp-tools/dist --target bun --format esm --external @ast-grep/napi && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --declarationDir .types && cp .types/packages/oh-my-opencode/src/index.d.ts packages/oh-my-opencode/dist/index.d.ts && cp .types/packages/opencode-task-delegation/src/index.d.ts packages/opencode-task-delegation/dist/index.d.ts && cp .types/packages/opencode-lsp-tools/src/index.d.ts packages/opencode-lsp-tools/dist/index.d.ts && rm -rf .types

author: YeonGyu-Kim
